evidence.name: Screen field: What the field accepts
evidence.userNeed: Know what "What the field accepts" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: What the field accepts
sections.description: Tells the field what kind of value to accept — plain text, a whole number, a decimal, a date, or an email — and automatically applies basic checks plus the right phone keyboard. Use Email for email capture and plain text for open answers. Picking the correct type blocks bad data, keeping any branching, analytics, or CRM that reads this answer reliable.
